trigger_context: Reviewing Fama/French 1993 literature card applicability boundaries during knowledge validation.

evidence_extension.literature_support: Fama & French (1993) Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds — foundational US equity factor model.
evidence_extension.a_share_relevance: Indirect. Three-factor model applies to A-share only as a boundary reference, not a tradable strategy.
applicability_limitations: Size and value factors defined on US CRSP/Compustat data.
Factor construction methodology assumes US market microstructure.
Direct migration to A-share without re-estimation introduces significant model risk.
Short-selling constraints in A-share break long-short factor portfolio assumptions.
evidence_extension.sample_constraint: Original study uses 1963-1990 US data. No A-share sample validation performed.
evidence_extension.market_regime_constraint: Factor efficacy varies by market regime. A-share has different sector concentration and retail investor dominance.
evidence_extension.transfer_risk: High. Factor definitions and portfolio construction cannot be directly ported to A-share context.

formal_pipeline_note: This is a real ScenarioTrace, not actor/HMAC formal pipeline PASS.
